title: NNN vs GTA 6
caption:
No Nut November 2026 patch notes:

Player entered the month with full willpower and a clean save file. Days 1 through 11 were cleared on hard difficulty with zero side quests. On Nov 12 the GTA VI preload started and willpower took 40% damage. On Nov 18 at 11:58pm, player was spotted refreshing the PlayStation Store with PTO approved, phone on Do Not Disturb, and a large pepperoni already on the way.

At 12:00am on Nov 19, player was officially eliminated. 18 days. 13 years. 2 delays. 0 regrets.

Rockstar has not confirmed whether the date was chosen on purpose, but the evidence is overwhelming.

Rated M for Mature. No Nut November is not rated by the ESRB. Progress will not be saved.

Follow @videogamers. We're also not making it to the 30th.

#videogamers #gta6 #nnn #gamingmemes #rockstargames
